text:
eric: Quick sync: AWS/GCP/Azure listings need final SKU matrix + short privacy/data blurb for legal. Target launch window = next sprint.
nina: I can coordinate with product for SKU names. Proposal: tiny / standard / pro becomes cpu-2 / cpu-4 / cpu-8 to align with cloud VM sizing. Easier for customers to map.
sam: Heads-up on Azure: offers require a single VM image per offer; we can use a single publisher image and publish VM size options, but the UI is limited on variable metering.
michelle: Legal asks whether we plan to support marketplace metered billing (e.g., usage-based token metering) or only subscriptions. Also need a one-paragraph data handling statement and a 2-line cancellation/refund snippet.
marketplace-bot: New task created: partners/marketplace#678 "Finalize SKU matrix & legal copy"  https://boards.example/678
eric: For parity, prefer to support both metered + subscription. If a platform blocks metering, we'll offer subscription-only at GA and add metered later. Nina can we map pricing equivalence across both modes?
nina: Yes. I'll build a CSV: sku_id,cloud_tier,vm_profile,billing_mode,monthly_equiv_usd. Example rows included.
sam: Also let's confirm image packaging: AWS needs AMI per region; GCP a single image family; Azure one managed image with marketplace offer. That affects our build pipeline. @michelle can legal accept the image distribution note?
michelle: Include statement: "Our published marketplace images contain Redwood inference runtime only; no customer data or customer-managed keys are embedded. Customers bring their data to the runtime during use." Also add: "Customers may choose Private/Dedicated deployments where keys and data remain in their tenancy."
eric: Good. For billing logging language, propose: "We log token-level billing metadata (counts, timestamps) for invoicing. Customers on Dedicated/Private may opt out of logging. No customer content is retained for billing."
michelle: Slight edit: remove absolute "no" claims. Better: "We retain token-level metadata used for billing and analytics. Customers on Dedicated/Private may opt out of metadata retention. We do not persist raw customer payloads beyond transient processing unless otherwise agreed."
nina: Noted. I'll include the approved legal blurb in the CSV export so marketplace listing copy picks it up.
eric: Marketing: we need 50-char descriptions per SKU for each cloud UI. Nina, can you draft one-liners? Eg: "Redwood Inference — up to 2 vCPU, metered". Nina: I'll draft 3 and push to /assets/marketplace/one-liners.txt.
sam: Ops note: AMI/Family naming must include build hash and version tag so marketplace patching works. Also request that image builds are signed.
michelle: Add a sentence about encryption & KMS: "Traffic TLS; private deployments integrate with customer KMS/HSM for key management."
eric: Action list: nina = SKU CSV + 3 one-liners by Thu; sam = confirm AMI/image publishing steps and upload checklist by Wed; michelle = finalize legal copy + refund/cancellation snippet by Thu AM; I'll follow up with finance for equivalent pricing.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist template is at /drive/marketplace/onboarding-checklist-v2.md
eric: Thanks all. We'll regroup after action items. :thumbsup:
